title: Homerton Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, hazards, and essential supplies in Homerton.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals (A&E):
- Homerton University Hospital: Homerton Row, E9 6SR. From Homerton station: ~5 min walk south along Barnabas Road and Homerton High Street to Homerton Row (approx 0.3 miles).
- The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Whitechapel Road, E1 1FR. From Homerton station: bus 242 southbound directly to Whitechapel (~25-30 min journey).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- City and Hackney Urgent Treatment Centre: Homerton University Hospital, Homerton Row, E9 6SR. Open 24/7 on the main hospital site.

3. Local Hazards & Infrastructure:
- River Lea / Hackney Cut navigation system to the east: designated flood plain and localized surge risks along Hackney Marshes and Hackney Wick borders.
- Railway underpasses along Homerton High Street and Wick Lane are prone to deep surface water accumulation in major storms.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Local chemists, mini-markets, and larger food stores on Homerton High Street, Well Street, and Chatsworth Road supply emergency water containers, basic medicine, hygiene supplies, and dry rations.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible (verify locally).
